name: rust
description: Rust development on the 2024 edition, built from the official Rust documentation, the Rust API Guidelines, and the Clippy book — the language and the standard library, with the edition-2024 changes and APIs stabilised through Rust 1.99; Cargo manifests, features, workspaces, profiles, build scripts, configuration, cross-compilation, and publishing; designing public APIs against the API Guidelines checklist; Clippy lint policy, clippy.toml, and rustfmt; reading compiler errors and lints; atomics, memory ordering, and building locks and other synchronization primitives, from Mara Bos's Rust Atomics and Locks; testing; rustdoc and doctests; and command-line applications on current crates. Ships a build-triage agent that returns only root-cause diagnostics, an API-review agent that checks a crate's public surface against the guidelines, a Stop gate that keeps a session from ending while cargo check fails after Rust edits, and a guard that asks before cargo publish, yank, and owner changes.
